news.title: The Bridge…To Salvation

reflection.title: New Beginnings
reflection.body: New seasons, new work and renewed spiritual growth call for courage. KCMC’s September reflection encourages the church to trust that God walks with us into change, prepares the way and multiplies each faithful gift and act of service.

highlights.label: August average attendance
highlights.detail: The September newsletter’s combined weekly attendance report.

highlights.label: Children and families served
highlights.detail: Nearly 600 people received support through the back-to-school fair.

highlights.label: Pairs of socks donated
highlights.detail: Church generosity gave each child a choice of four pairs.

highlights.label: Weekend food bags
highlights.detail: WEB Kids volunteers pack bags each week for Reeds Spring Primary students.

sections.label: Giving
sections.title: Finance and giving update
sections.body: July giving followed the usual summer dip. General Fund giving totaled about $37,000, and reserve funds helped bridge the month’s shortfall so KCMC ministries could continue.

sections.label: Outreach
sections.title: Thank you for sharing God’s love
sections.body: Donations and volunteers helped serve nearly 600 children and families at the back-to-school fair. More than 4,000 pairs of socks were available, giving children choices and practical support for the school year.

sections.label: Serve
sections.title: WEB Kids volunteers needed
sections.body: Volunteers meet Thursdays at 9:00 AM at Reeds Spring Primary to pack 100 weekend food bags for K–4 students. Sign up at the volunteer table in the foyer.

sections.label: Learning
sections.title: Request a Bible study
sections.body: KCMC is planning fall studies and welcomes ideas for topics and resources. Contact the church office to suggest a study.

sections.label: Music
sections.title: A place for your voice and both hands
sections.body: Chancel Choir and Bell Choir welcome new participants. No prior handbell experience is required; the team will teach you.

sections.label: Church story
sections.title: Stained glass: the Apostle Philip
sections.body: The fourth window on the right recalls Philip, the Cross and the feeding of the 5,000 through the image of two loaves of bread.
